text: An Nulaaɗo, maakan ɓee sirkooɓe ɗuurniiɓe e goonga: yeetee lam fii sanamuuji mon ɗi rewoton accon Allah ɗin, ko honɗum e geɗe ɗi tagi e leydi ndin? Hara ko fello? Kaa ko ilol? Kaa hara hiɗi kafidi e Allah ka tagugol kammuuli ɗin? Awa addanee lam Deftere jipporiinde ka Allah, ado ndee Alqur'aanaare, maa batte ganndal ko adinooɓe acii, si wonii ko on goonguɓe e ko nodditorton, wonnde sanamuuji mon ɗin hino hanndi e reweede!
